summary: Ryanair Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K announcing a final dividend of €0.195 per ordinary share for FY26, subject to shareholder approval at the AGM on 10 September 2026. The ex-dividend date is 6 August 2026, record date is 7 August 2026, and payment date is 17 September 2026. The filing provides administrative details on dividend payment methods, currency conversion through an International Payments Service, and Irish dividend withholding tax at 25%. This is a routine dividend declaration and not a special situation, as it does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other transformative event.
